comments.title: A shorter opening
comments.explanation: Lead with the lemma while retaining the reference.
comments.original: It follows from Lemma~\ref{lem:ordering} that the allocation is monotone.
comments.replacement: By Lemma~\ref{lem:ordering}, the allocation is monotone.

comments.title: Start the proof directly
comments.original: In order to establish the claim, we consider the identity allocation.

comments.title: Exclude the zero endpoint
comments.explanation: At theta = 0, the allocation equals zero. The strict inequality needs an open lower endpoint.
comments.original: The latter inequality is strict for every $\theta\in[0,1]$.
comments.replacement: The latter inequality is strict for every $\theta\in(0,1]$.

comments.title: Use a definition symbol
comments.explanation: This optional notation change also requires the mathtools package. Both edits are checked together.

comments.title: Is a density assumption needed here?
comments.explanation: The pointwise optimum in this example does not depend on the density. Consider explaining why this assumption is retained.
comments.original: The distribution $F$ has a continuous density on $[0,1]$.
